description.en-US: Fifty-seven letters of spiritual direction by St. John of Ávila, translated into English (Rouen, 1631), to preachers, priests, noblemen, ladies, maidens and religious. Each letter carries the number it has in the Spanish Epistolario espiritual of this corpus; letters that book lacks are marked with their number in Sala Balust's critical edition (BAC 1952) or as unidentified. The translator's preface is not included; his marginal scripture references are footnotes.
description.pt-BR: Cinquenta e sete cartas de direção espiritual de São João de Ávila na tradução inglesa de Rouen (1631).

sources.edition: Certain Selected Spiritual Epistles written by that most Reverend holy man Doctor Ioan de Auila, At Roüen by the widow of Nicolas Courant, 1631; EEBO-TCP A23433 (EarlyPrint normalised spelling).
sources.description: All 57 letters, with the editor's one-line summary of each in italics. Illegible characters of the keying appear as ●. The correspondence with the Spanish letter numbers was made by comparing the summaries of the two editions, not word by word.
sources.tierEvidence: Printed 1631; the TCP keyed text is released CC0.
